correctness.rationale: For every a,b>=2 and every feasible full labeled degree vector, the product-weight complete-bipartite tree polynomial factors as (prod x)(prod y)(sum x)^(b-1)(sum y)^(a-1). Effective-resistance transfer-current determinants and multinomial coefficient extraction produce the displayed exact edge marginal P=u_i+v_j-u_i*v_j and all three joint-pair cases using U,V without-replacement factors; their incident covariance is <=0, while disjoint covariance has either sign. The K(2,3) degree-conditioned witness has maximal Bernoulli covariance 1/4 and the K(t,t),t>=4, degree-two-endpoint family is positive. Reconstructed finite edge-subset spanning trees, degree strata and every edge pair for K(2,2), K(2,3), K(3,3), K(3,4), K(4,4); finite checks are not the universal proof. One-position m=1 or p=1 boundaries use explicitly zero second factorial moments. Independently reconstructed exact seven-file Git tree SHA.
